$comment: Chart-specific additions to the shared values schema, deep-merged by hack/gen-helm-values-schema.py (make gen-helm-schema).

barbicanOperator.description: Identity of the barbican-operator, rendered as the BARBICAN_OPERATOR_NAMESPACE and BARBICAN_OPERATOR_SERVICE_ACCOUNT environment variables on the manager container. It is the subject of the TokenRequest grant (Role/RoleBinding) the operator projects next to every dedicated OpenBao instance, and the NetworkPolicy peer that instance admits, so both fields must match the release the barbican-operator chart is installed as

serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount the barbican-operator pod runs as
